terminology_highlights: India Leaf Tobacco Division (ILTD) — Indian Leaf Tobacco Development, the division responsible for sourcing, processing, and exporting tobacco leaves.
TM&D — Trade Marketing & Distribution, ITC's massive FMCG distribution highway reaching millions of retail outlets.
FCV Tobacco — Flue Cured Virginia, the primary high-quality tobacco crop sourced from farmers in Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka.
Paan Shop / Kiosk — The ubiquitous micro-retail outlets across India that form the last-mile node for cigarette sales.
